text:
lotte: FYI I hit a weird onboarding failure in the TS quickstart after the export map change. `tsc` errors about missing typings and runtime fails with "Cannot find module 'sdk'" when using require.

henry: same here in CI. node:cjs job fails, stack shows `node:internal/modules/cjs/loader: Module not found`. our package.json used to have `main` + `module` as fallbacks.

adele: I think the new exports map only exposes the ESM edge bundle and didn't provide a CJS `require` path or a legacy default export. that breaks older sample apps and a lot of consumer repos.

deps-bot: dependency update #sdk@v2.3.0 changed "exports" -> removed legacy entrypoints (changelog: https://deps.redwood/sdk/2.3.0)

lotte: minimal repro: in sample-app/node/index.js `const sdk = require('sdk')` -> fails. `import sdk from 'sdk'` in edge sample gives `The requested module does not provide an export named 'default'`.

henry: additional problem: our published types point at `types/index.d.ts` but consumers importing subpaths (like `sdk/auth`) get no type resolution. TS then falls back to `any` and some of our typedef-only helpers break.

adele: I sketched a compat exports map in PR comments: `exports.{".":{"node":{"require":"./dist/node/index.cjs","import":"./dist/node/index.mjs"},"default":"./dist/edge/index.mjs"}}` plus `types` top-level. would that cover both run and typing cases?

lotte: looks right. two more notes: 1) we should add `./auth` subpath exports if we expect people to import `sdk/auth` in samples. 2) consider retaining a thin CJS proxy that re-exports default to support `require()` -> `module.exports = require('./dist/node/index.cjs')`.

taylor: practical unblock: update sample-app to explicit imports (`import sdk from 'sdk/edge'`) so new users at least can run quickstarts, then follow with a proper exports fix in SDK package.

henry: agree but we must update docs too. most copy-paste examples assume `import sdk from 'sdk'`.

deps-bot: CI suite failing on 3 PRs related to exports changes. See https://ci.internal/redwood-inference/exports-compat for failures.

lotte: action plan I propose:
- rollback the strict exports tweak in main to restore parity (temporary)
- add conditional exports in a follow-up with explicit paths for node.require, node.import, and edge.default
- add subpath exports for commonly used internal modules (./auth, ./types) and ensure `types` top-level points to bundled declarations
- add CI matrix tests (node:cjs, node:esm, cloudflare) on any PR touching package.json or exports

adele: I'll open the follow-up PR for conditional exports + subpath typings. taylor can patch sample-apps to explicit edge/node imports as a short-term fix.

taylor: will do a docs patch too. tagging @eng-ml to be aware since retry/auth behavior might differ between bundles.

lotte: thanks. please ping here when the rollback PR is up so I can rerun onboarding E2E.
